content.title: ADP Sees Negative -32K Jobs in September

content.summary: Inflation is still present, but not running out of control. Sounds like "Goldilocks" to pre-market traders.

content.title: Market Indexes Stay Lower 2nd Straight Day, PCE On Deck
content.summary: We've run out of near-term catalysts for a refreshment to the bull run, at least until tomorrow's PCE report comes out.

content.title: 4 Top-Performing ETF Areas of First Nine Months of 2025
content.summary: In 2025, the best-performing ETF themes include gold and silver mining (SLVP, RING), bitcoin miners (WGMI), uranium (URA) and defense (EUAD, SHLD).

content.title: A Late Summer Reflection on Growth, Inflation & Jobs

content.summary: We now have interest rates between 4.00-4.25% for the first time since December of 2022.

content.title: Housing Numbers Down Ahead of Fed Rate Cut Today
